subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood Inference & NovaEdge - draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@novaedge.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood Inference & NovaEdge - draft & timeline options

Hi Samir / Lena,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand NovaEdge's latency and compliance needs for the new customer-facing assistant. As discussed, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to capture milestones, owners, and dependencies so we can lock the timeline and surface any risks early.

I'm attaching the draft (MAP_NovaEdge_v1.xlsx). High-level summary below:

Proposed MAP (initial draft)
- Target close date: 2026-07-30 (end of month)
- Key milestones and owners:
  1) Technical discovery & infra sizing (complete) — Owner: NovaEdge (Samir, Lena) — Due: 2026-06-12
  2) Private deployment scoping & network review — Owner: Redwood (Aditya) — Due: 2026-06-19
  3) Security questionnaire & evidence pack (SOC2 docs, data-retention policy) — Owner: NovaEdge / Redwood (shared) — Due: 2026-06-24
  4) Proof-of-concept (Dedicated capacity) — Owner: Redwood (Dev) — Due: 2026-07-08
  5) Procurement & contract review — Owner: NovaEdge (David) — Due: 2026-07-15
  6) Final verification & go/no-go — Owner: Both — Due: 2026-07-25

Dependencies / open items:
- Procurement timeline (PO/terms) — please confirm David as the procurement owner and expected lead times.
- Network/VPC peering details for private deployment — Aditya will send a list of required firewall rules and IP ranges.
- Any additional compliance evidence (specific regulatory requirements) — flag now so we can include in the security pack.

Options for MAP review meeting (30–45 min):
- Option A: Mon 2026-06-15, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Option B: Tue 2026-06-16, 13:00–13:45 PT
- Option C: Wed 2026-06-17, 09:00–09:45 PT

Ask: can you confirm the full stakeholder list (technical, legal/procurement, executive approver) and which meeting slot works best? If procurement needs a different cadence, we can shift the timeline — the draft target close date is flexible within July.

Next steps from our side:
- Aditya will follow up with the private-deployment checklist and expected firewall/IPs.
- Dev will provision a Dedicated capacity POC window aligned to the dates above.
- I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with any stakeholder changes and push a final copy after the review meeting.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachment: MAP_NovaEdge_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear MAP. This looks good overall and I like having milestones split by owner. A couple notes: 

- Confirming David Chen (dchen@novaedge.com) will own procurement/contract side — looping him in separately.
- Lena (product) will own final verification and acceptance testing.
- On the security pack: we need a copy of your SOC2 Type II report and retention policy confirmation. If you can include a short README in the Drive link that explains what each doc is, that will help speed review.

Option B (Tue 6/16 13:00 PT) works best for our team. Sending over a calendar invite once I confirm with David.

Regards,
